about_the_game:
Push Boulders and Watch Them Fall

The catacombs are a dangerous place to visit, filled with falling boulders, deadly miasma, ravenous plants, and much more. Learn the rules that govern these depths to solve puzzles and make progress.

Face the Monsters Lurking in the Darkness

The various monster you encounter will haunt your dreams, and kill you if you get too close. Yet, figuring out how each of them moves and behaves is key to descend through the chambers, towards your ultimate goal, escape!

Escape the Catacombs and Save the Town

Uncover the secrets lurking in the catacombs: Who trapped you down here, and why? Who built these halls, and what is the source of the all the other-wordly horrors inhabiting them? 

Enjoy the Sights and Sounds

Abysm has hand-crafted pixels with a 16 bit vibe, coupled with atmospheric sounds and music. Explore the stylish catacombs.

Four Episodes of Puzzle Fun and Story

Abysm consist of four episode, each with 18 levels of increasingly challenging puzzles. Throughout your journey down the Catacombs of Portsmoor is woven a story of deception, mystery, and trying to get out alive.

short_description: Explore the Catacombs of Portsmoor, solve puzzles, uncover the secrets that are lurking in the darkness, and save both yourself and the town above. Abysm is an atmospheric puzzle game, inspired by classics such as Boulder Dash, Supaplex, or Emerald Mines.
